Nora: Concordance follow-up: they confirmed target 400 qps per region (us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 DR), average 320 tokens, max 512. Require p95 < 120ms after auth and KMS + audit logs. Can we schedule a PoC next week?

Diego: Quick checks: steady 30m holds with occasional 5s microbursts? Model: ~7B quantized OK?

Nora: Yes steady-state + a few microbursts. They prefer 7B and accept quantization. They want Dedicated inside their VPC if possible.

Lina: Proposed configuration: rwd-open-7b q8_256, 3 nodes/region (2 active + 1 spare) on A10GX-equivalent. Ramp 0->400 qps in 5m, hold 30m, inject 8 microbursts. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, token/sec, cold-start traces, per-request logs.

Lina: k6 command example:
```
k6 run --vus 400 --duration 40m poc.js --env MODEL=rwd-open-7b --env REGION=us-west-2
```

Diego: KMS: managed adds ~4-8ms; customer-KMS over DirectConnect may add +10-25ms. Concordance insists p95 after auth remains <120ms so simulate both paths.

ops-bot: Tentative slot Thu 2026-04-02 11:00 PT. 48h confirmation required.

Nora: Tentatively book and confirm with Concordance. Sales ask: need ballpark monthly committed price for Dedicated + VPC option with 99.9% SLA. Lina please include tokens/sec and SKU list for pricing.

Lina: Back-of-envelope: at 400 qps ~120k tokens/sec per region (avg 300 tokens). 3 nodes/region -> both regions ~6 node-hours equivalent. Monthly committed estimate will follow once SKUs chosen and discount applied. Fallback plan: if p95 >120ms, increase node count or switch quant profile to lower latency variant.

Nora: Deliverables: perf report (latency percentiles and curves), cost comparison hosted vs private-VPC, runbook, security Q answers, short recording of tail behavior. I'll confirm schedule and get Concordance sign-off. Thanks!
